story.text: 반포대교 여기 자리, 제가 제일 좋아하는 곳이에요. 오늘은 특별히 승객님한테만 보여드리고 싶었어요.
story.reading: ban-po-dae-gyo yeo-gi ja-ri, je-ga je-il jo-a-ha-neun got-i-e-yo. o-neul-eun teuk-byeol-hi seung-gaek-nim-han-te-man bo-yeo-deu-ri-go si-peot-seo-yo.
story.en: This spot at Banpo Bridge is my favorite place. Today I especially wanted to show it only to you.

story.text: 이 '야경', 매일 봐도 안 질리는데, 오늘따라 옆에 승객님이 있어서 더 예뻐 보이네요.
story.reading: i ya-gyeong, mae-il bwa-do an jil-li-neun-de, o-neul-tta-ra yeop-e seung-gaek-nim-i i-sseo-seo deo ye-ppeo bo-i-ne-yo.
story.en: This 'night view' never gets old no matter how many times I see it, but today it looks even more beautiful with you beside me.

story.text: 저기 달빛무지개 '분수' 물줄기 보이죠? 타이밍 맞춰서 왔거든요, 승객님 보여주려고.
story.reading: jeo-gi dal-bit-mu-ji-gae bun-su mul-jul-gi bo-i-jyo? ta-i-ming mat-chwo-seo wat-geo-deun-yo, seung-gaek-nim bo-yeo-ju-ryeo-go.
story.en: Can you see the Moonlight Rainbow 'fountain' over there? I timed it on purpose, just to show you.

story.text: 평소엔 무슨 말이든 '여유' 있게 잘하는데, 오늘은 이상하게 그게 잘 안 되네요. 방금 뭔가 말하려다가... 아니, 아무것도 아니에요.
story.reading: pyeong-so-en mu-seun mal-i-deun yeo-yu it-ge jal-ha-neun-de, o-neul-eun i-sang-ha-ge geu-ge jal an doe-ne-yo. bang-geum mwon-ga mal-ha-ryeo-da-ga... a-ni, a-mu-geot-do a-ni-e-yo.
story.en: Normally I can talk about anything with 'composure', but today, oddly, I just can't manage it. I almost said something just now... never mind, it's nothing.

story.text: 이 '순간'만큼은 능글맞은 농담 대신, 그냥 솔직하게 있고 싶어요. 근데 자꾸 말이 목에서 걸리네요.
story.reading: i sun-gan-man-keum-eun neung-geul-maj-eun nong-dam dae-sin, geu-nyang sol-jik-ha-ge it-go si-peo-yo. geun-de ja-kku mal-i mok-e-seo geol-li-ne-yo.
story.en: Just for this 'moment', instead of my usual smooth jokes, I just want to be honest. But the words keep catching in my throat.

story.text: 왜 아무 말도 안 해요? 이 '침묵', 저 지금 심장 터질 것 같은데.
story.reading: wae a-mu mal-do an hae-yo? i chim-muk, jeo ji-geum sim-jang teo-jil geot gat-eun-de.
story.en: Why aren't you saying anything? This 'silence' is making my heart feel like it's about to burst.

story.text: ...크흠, 오늘은 여기까지만 할게요. 배운 단어들, 문제로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ...keu-heum, o-neul-eun yeo-gi-kka-ji-man hal-ge-yo. bae-un dan-eo-deul, mun-je-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: ...ahem, let's stop here for today. Shall we check the words we learned with some questions?

words.example_en: The Han River night view is truly beautiful.
The Banpo Bridge fountain has started.
I have no composure at all today.

words.example: 이 순간을 오래 기억할 것 같아요.
words.example_reading: i sun-gan-eul o-rae gi-eok-hal geot gat-a-yo
words.example_en: I think I'll remember this moment for a long time.
After a long silence, he spoke.
